key.name: restore-tabs
key.description: Whether the windows and tabs that were open when wig was last closed are opened again.

key.name: tab-layout
key.description: Whether tabs are listed in a bar above the page or in a sidebar beside it.

key.name: feature-overrides
key.description: WebKit feature identifiers mapped to the value they are forced to on startup. Features left out of this list keep whatever value WebKit defaults them to.

key.name: https-navigation-policy
key.description: Whether navigations typed as http are upgraded to https. HTTPS-First falls back to http when the https load fails, HTTPS-Only reports an error instead.

key.name: search-engine
key.description: A URL template where %s is replaced by the escaped search terms.

key.name: javascript-can-open-windows-automatically
key.description: Whether a page can open a window without the user asking it to.

key.name: auto-load-images
key.description: Whether images are fetched as a page loads.

key.name: media-playback-requires-user-gesture
key.summary: Require a Click Before Media Plays
key.description: Whether audio and video wait for the user to start them rather than playing on their own.

key.name: zoom-text-only
key.description: Whether zooming resizes only the text, leaving images and layout at their own size.

key.name: enable-javascript
key.description: Whether the scripts a page carries are run.
